$schema_note: Curated human docs for console vars. Not exhaustive. Keys match CONSOLE_VAR ids as shown in /consolevars UI. process: engine|anim|both

recipes.title: Face boxes on the face LCD (MirrorMode)
recipes.blurb: Camera feed on Vector’s screen with OpenCV-style face (and related) overlays. The mode must be scheduled AND the mirror display flags enabled.
recipes.where: Engine :8888 → Vision tab → General.VisionModes + Vision.General / Vision.MirrorMode

steps.note: Vision mode: run face detection so there is something to draw.
Vision mode: render camera to the face display (mirror screen).
Draw detections (objects/faces/markers) into the mirror image.
Extra face/eye-contact debug drawing in mirror (what many people mean by ‘boundary boxes’).

tips: All of these are engine consolevars (port 8888), not anim 8889.
Faces + MirrorMode are under Vision.General.VisionModes (enum-named toggles).
If the face screen stays dark, confirm image capture is running and the robot is not in a screen that overrides MirrorMode.

recipes.title: Marker / charger detections in MirrorMode
recipes.blurb: See fiducial / marker overlays on the face camera feed.

steps.note: If > 0, also labels marker names (0–1 scale).

tips: kDisplayMarkerNamesScale is under Vision.MirrorMode; 0 hides names.

recipes.title: Stream mood into WebViz
recipes.blurb: Ensure mood samples reach the Mood WebViz tab at a useful rate.

steps.note: Seconds between mood pushes to WebViz (smaller = more traffic).

tips: Open WebViz → Mood and Subscribe; period is also adjustable from that tab.

Vision.blurb: Camera pipeline, vision modes, mirror display, and face/marker debug. Engine process only.

Vision.General.VisionModes.blurb: Per-VisionMode force-enable toggles (Faces, MirrorMode, Markers, …). Enabling also Dev-subscribes the mode so it is scheduled.

Vision.MirrorMode.blurb: Drawing options for the on-face camera mirror image (detections, exposure text, gamma).

Vision.General.blurb: Cross-cutting vision debug flags (e.g. eye-contact drawing in mirror).

Faces.blurb: Force-enable VisionMode::Faces (face detection). Needed before face overlays have data.

MirrorMode.blurb: Force-enable VisionMode::MirrorMode — camera feed composited onto the face LCD.

Markers.blurb: Force-enable marker / fiducial detection vision mode.

kDisplayEyeContactInMirrorMode.blurb: When MirrorMode is active, draw eye-contact / face debug (often the ‘boxes’ people notice).

kDisplayDetectionsInMirrorMode.blurb: Draw detected objects, faces, and markers into the MirrorMode image.

kDisplayExposureInMirrorMode.blurb: Overlay exposure / AE info on the mirror image.

kDisplayMarkerNamesScale.blurb: Scale for marker name labels in mirror (0 = off).

kMirrorModeGamma.blurb: Gamma adjustment for the mirrored camera image.

kMirrorModeFaceDebugFontScale.blurb: Font scale for face debug text in mirror mode.

kSendDebugImages.blurb: Send debug image streams from the vision system (bandwidth heavy).

MoodManager_WebVizPeriod_s.blurb: How often mood state is pushed to WebViz Mood tab.

WebvizUpdatePeriod.blurb: Period used by some WebViz CPU-related updates.

ProfilerLogOutput.blurb: Profiler logging level (WebViz CpuProfile may set this).
